I fixed it, and `node test.js` now passes (it prints `OK`).

The problem was in `broken.js`: `parseDuration` only recognised hours and minutes and skipped any seconds. So an input like `"1h55m26s"` came out as 6900 instead of 6926, and that caused all 15 failures. I changed the pattern so it also matches seconds (`[hms]`) and added a branch that adds the seconds to the total. I didn't touch `test.js`.
